list.name: ds_cm
list.label: SCCM Database
list.description: Microsoft SQL Server data source for the Configuration Manager site database (CM_<site code>), with a read-only login. Chosen automatically if its name contains "SCCM", "ConfigMgr" or "Configuration Manager"; otherwise pick it here.

list.definition:
SELECT Name AS __text, CollectionID AS __value
FROM dbo.v_Collection
WHERE CollectionType = 2
ORDER BY Name
list.label: Collection
list.name: cmcoll
list.query:
SELECT Name AS __text, CollectionID AS __value
FROM dbo.v_Collection
WHERE CollectionType = 2
ORDER BY Name

title: SCCM - Client Health

panels.description: Clients that have reported to the site recently.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT s.Client0, cs.ClientActiveStatus, cs.LastEvaluationHealthy
  FROM dbo.v_ClientCollectionMembers m
  JOIN dbo.v_R_System s ON s.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
  LEFT JOIN dbo.v_CH_ClientSummary cs ON cs.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
  WHERE m.CollectionID = '${cmcoll}'
), comp AS (
  SELECT Status FROM dbo.v_ComponentSummarizer WHERE TallyInterval = '0001128000100008'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS [Devices],
  SUM(CASE WHEN Client0 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Clients],
  SUM(CASE WHEN Client0 = 1 AND ClientActiveStatus = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Active clients],
  SUM(CASE WHEN Client0 = 1 AND ISNULL(ClientActiveStatus, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Inactive clients],
  SUM(CASE WHEN Client0 = 1 AND LastEvaluationHealthy = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Clients failing health checks],
  SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(Client0, 0) <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Devices without a client],
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.v_SiteSystemSummarizer WHERE Status > 0) AS [Site systems not healthy],
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comp WHERE Status > 0) AS [Components not healthy]
FROM c

panels.title: Devices without a client

panels.description: Health: Critical = inactive client, Warning = active but failed its health evaluation, Not monitored = no client or no client summary yet. The date columns are when each client cycle last reported.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s.Name0 AS [Device],
  CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.Client0, 0) <> 1 THEN 0 WHEN cs.ClientActiveStatus IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN cs.ClientActiveStatus = 0 THEN 3 WHEN cs.LastEvaluationHealthy = 0 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS [Health],
  CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.Client0, 0) <> 1 THEN 'No client' WHEN cs.ClientActiveStatus = 1 THEN 'Active' WHEN cs.ClientActiveStatus = 0 THEN 'Inactive' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS [Activity],
  CASE cs.LastEvaluationHealthy WHEN 1 THEN 'Passed' WHEN 0 THEN 'Failed' ELSE '-' END AS [Health check],
  ISNULL(NULLIF(s.Client_Version0, ''), '-') AS [Client version],
  COALESCE(REPLACE(o.Caption0, 'Microsoft ', ''), REPLACE(ISNULL(s.Operating_System_Name_and0, 'Unknown'), 'Microsoft Windows NT ', '')) AS [OS],
  cs.LastPolicyRequest AS [Last policy request],
  cs.LastDDR AS [Last heartbeat],
  COALESCE(cs.LastHW, w.LastHWScan) AS [Last hardware inventory],
  cs.LastSW AS [Last software inventory],
  cs.LastOnline AS [Last online],
  cs.LastMPServerName AS [Management point]
FROM dbo.v_ClientCollectionMembers m
JOIN dbo.v_R_System s ON s.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
LEFT JOIN dbo.v_CH_ClientSummary cs ON cs.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
LEFT JOIN dbo.v_GS_OPERATING_SYSTEM o ON o.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
LEFT JOIN dbo.v_GS_WORKSTATION_STATUS w ON w.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
WHERE m.CollectionID = '${cmcoll}'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ISNULL(s.Client0, 0) <> 1 THEN 1 WHEN cs.ClientActiveStatus = 0 THEN 3 WHEN cs.LastEvaluationHealthy = 0 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END DESC, s.Name0
